articles.title: 🚨 Massive Fire at Delhi College Library – Hundreds of Books Lost
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major fire broke out this morning (May 15) at the library of Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, Pitampura, Delhi.

body.html:
A major fire broke out this morning (May 15) at the library of Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, Pitampura, Delhi.

🕗 Time: Around 8:55 am
🔥 Cause: Suspected short circuit in the server

🏢 Damage:
● Fire engulfed 3 floors of the 4-storey library
● Hundreds of books, especially old collections, were destroyed
● Window panes shattered from the heat
● No injuries reported, thanks to early timing

🚒 Response:
● 11 fire tenders rushed to the spot
● Fire was controlled by 9:40 am
● Cooling operations continued to prevent flare-ups

📹 Videos showing thick black smoke and flames have gone viral.

👮‍♂️ Police are investigating.
College officials say it could’ve been far worse had it occurred after 10 am when students fill the building.

📚 A major cultural and academic loss.
⚠️ Raises urgent questions about electrical safety and disaster preparedness in public institutions.

body.html:
A disturbing video from Muzaffarnagar's Nai Mandi area has gone viral, showing businessman Vishu Tayal brutally assaulting his driver with the help of a bouncer. Tayal is seen slapping the driver 20 times and filming the incident, which he reportedly sent to other drivers as a warning.
